problems.title: Safe Drinking Water Access in 15 Villages of Gumla Block
problems.situation: Approximately 15 villages in Gumla block lack access to safe drinking water. Residents rely on contaminated open wells and ponds, leading to frequent waterborne disease outbreaks affecting 8,000+ people annually.
problems.gap: Existing borewells are either non-functional due to lack of maintenance or have high fluoride content. No systematic water quality monitoring is in place.
problems.desired_outcome: Design a cost-effective water purification and distribution system for 15 villages serving 8,000+ people, with a community-operated maintenance model, within 6 months and ₹2L budget.
problems.constraints: Budget ₹2L, remote terrain, no electricity in 5 villages, community must operate it

problems.title: Fluoride Contamination Mapping and Remediation in Khunti District
problems.situation: Groundwater in 23 villages of Khunti district shows fluoride levels 3-8x above WHO safe limits. Dental and skeletal fluorosis is prevalent in children and adults.
problems.gap: No real-time fluoride monitoring system exists. Defluoridation units installed in 2019 are 60% non-functional due to lack of maintenance capacity.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy IoT-based water quality monitoring at 23 sites with automated alerts and a trained local technician network capable of maintaining defluoridation units.
problems.constraints: Intermittent electricity, low digital literacy of technicians, ₹5L budget

problems.title: Watershed Rejuvenation for Drought-Prone Panchayats in Hazaribagh
problems.situation: 12 gram panchayats in Hazaribagh face severe drought conditions annually. Groundwater table has dropped 4 meters in the last decade. Crop failures affect 15,000 farming families.
problems.gap: No watershed management plan exists. Traditional johads (water ponds) have been abandoned. Farmers lack knowledge of rainwater harvesting techniques.
problems.desired_outcome: Develop a GIS-based watershed rejuvenation plan for 12 panchayats with community rainwater harvesting structures to raise groundwater table by 1.5m within 2 monsoon seasons.
problems.constraints: Multi-panchayat coordination, seasonal fieldwork constraints

problems.title: Reducing Maternal Mortality in Remote Tribal Blocks of Gumla
problems.situation: Gumla district has a maternal mortality rate 3x the Jharkhand average. Pregnant women in remote blocks travel 40-60 km to reach primary health centres, often arriving too late for emergency care.
problems.gap: ASHA workers lack basic emergency obstetric care training and equipment. No telemedicine solution connects them to doctors in Ranchi during emergencies.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy a low-bandwidth telemedicine solution connecting 50 ASHA workers to on-call doctors, reducing median emergency response time from 4 hours to under 30 minutes.
problems.constraints: 2G connectivity in most areas, ASHA workers have basic smartphones, low digital literacy

problems.title: Malnutrition Screening and Tracking System for Anganwadi Centres in Ranchi
problems.situation: 45 Anganwadi centres in Ranchi district report malnutrition rates of 28% in children under 5. Manual paper records make tracking and intervention difficult.
problems.gap: No digital system tracks child growth parameters. Nutritional interventions are not personalised. Supervisors cannot identify which centres need urgent attention.
problems.desired_outcome: A mobile-based child health tracking app for 45 Anganwadis that automates growth monitoring, flags severe acute malnutrition, and generates monthly intervention reports.
problems.constraints: Workers are semi-literate, Android devices provided, Jharkhand official language Hindi

problems.title: Low-Cost Sickle Cell Disease Screening for Tribal Communities in Khunti
problems.situation: Sickle cell disease affects an estimated 15-20% of tribal populations in Khunti. Diagnosis requires expensive electrophoresis tests unavailable at PHC level.
problems.gap: No point-of-care screening solution exists at PHC or sub-centre level. Most cases are diagnosed only after severe crises, when damage is irreversible.
problems.desired_outcome: Develop or adapt a point-of-care sickle cell screening protocol usable by health workers at sub-centre level with <₹50 per test cost and >90% sensitivity.
problems.constraints: No lab infrastructure, cold chain limitations, ₹50 per test maximum

problems.title: Precision Irrigation Advisory System for Small Farmers in Deoghar
problems.situation: 12,000 small and marginal farmers in Deoghar district lose 30-40% of crops annually to either drought stress or waterlogging from imprecise irrigation.
problems.gap: Farmers have no access to soil moisture data or weather-based irrigation advice. Extension workers visit each farm once monthly at most.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy a low-cost soil moisture sensor network with SMS/voice-based irrigation advisory in Hindi for 500 pilot farmers, targeting 25% reduction in water use and 20% yield improvement.
problems.constraints: Farmers have basic mobile phones, no smartphones. Voice/SMS only. Low cost sensors needed.

problems.title: Post-Harvest Loss Reduction for Tomato Farmers in Bokaro
problems.situation: Tomato farmers in Bokaro district lose 35-50% of produce post-harvest due to lack of cold storage, poor packaging, and inadequate market linkages. Farmgate prices are ₹2-4/kg while retail is ₹25-40/kg.
problems.gap: No community cold storage within 50km. Farmers have no price information before harvest. Middlemen capture 70-80% of value.
problems.desired_outcome: Design a community cold chain solution (1-2 metric ton capacity) and market linkage mobile app connecting farmers directly to Ranchi and Jamshedpur wholesale buyers.
problems.constraints: Electricity supply intermittent, cooperative model preferred

problems.title: Regenerative Agriculture Practices for Degraded Tribal Lands in Dumka
problems.situation: 5,000 hectares of tribal agricultural land in Dumka district has degraded severely due to monoculture and excessive chemical fertiliser use. Soil organic matter has dropped below 0.3%.
problems.gap: Farmers are unaware of regenerative practices. Govt extension services reach <15% of farmers annually.
problems.desired_outcome: Train 200 tribal farmer champions in regenerative agriculture (composting, crop rotation, green manure) through demonstration plots, with measurable soil organic matter increase of 0.5% in 2 seasons.
problems.constraints: Language: Santali and Hindi. Low formal education. Demonstration plot approach preferred.

problems.title: Reducing School Dropout Rate Among Tribal Girls in Giridih
problems.situation: School dropout rate for tribal girls aged 12-16 in Giridih district is 42%, three times the national average. Primary reasons: distance to school, safety concerns, domestic responsibilities.
problems.gap: No targeted intervention tracks at-risk girls. Teachers have no alert system. School management has no district-level visibility.
problems.desired_outcome: Build a dropout early-warning system for 120 tribal schools in Giridih using attendance data + teacher input, enabling timely intervention and targeting 15% reduction in dropout in Year 1.
problems.constraints: Basic Android tablets available in schools. Teachers semi-literate in digital tools.

problems.title: Bilingual Learning Platform for Grade 3-5 Tribal Students in Jharkhand
problems.situation: Grade 3-5 students in tribal-dominated blocks struggle with Hindi-medium instruction when their mother tongue is Santali, Mundari, or Ho. This is the primary cause of early learning failure.
problems.gap: No digital learning content exists in tribal languages. Teachers are not trained in mother-tongue-based multilingual education.
problems.desired_outcome: Develop an offline-capable bilingual learning app (Hindi + Santali) for Grades 3-5 covering Mathematics and Science, with gamified exercises usable on low-end Android tablets.
problems.constraints: Must work offline. Low-end Android (512MB RAM). Santali in Ol-Chiki script required.

problems.title: Smart Street Lighting System for 5 Urban Wards in Ranchi
problems.situation: 5 wards in Ranchi South consume ₹80,000/month on street lighting. 30% of lights are on during daytime. 15% are faulty for weeks with no automated fault reporting.
problems.gap: No IoT-based monitoring system exists. Municipal staff rely on citizen complaints for fault detection. No dimming or scheduling capability.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy an IoT-based smart street light management system for 500 lights across 5 wards with automated scheduling, dimming, fault alerts, and energy monitoring — targeting 40% energy savings.
problems.constraints: Existing light poles must be retrofitted. Municipal approval required.

problems.title: Rural Road Condition Monitoring Using Mobile Crowdsourcing in Dhanbad
problems.situation: Dhanbad district has 1,200 km of rural roads. Only 30% have been inspected in the last 2 years. Road maintenance budget is allocated without data on actual road conditions.
problems.gap: No systematic road condition assessment. Manual inspection is slow, expensive, and infrequent. Budget allocation is not evidence-based.
problems.desired_outcome: Develop a crowdsourcing app where delivery drivers and ASHA workers report road conditions with GPS location and photos, generating a real-time road quality heatmap for the district PWD office.
problems.constraints: Android app. Works on 2G. GPS and camera required.

problems.title: Air Quality Monitoring Network for Coal Mine Areas in Dhanbad
problems.situation: Residents near Jharia coal fields in Dhanbad report severe respiratory issues. No official air quality monitoring exists beyond 3 CPCB stations, covering <5% of affected area.
problems.gap: Citizens and local health workers have no data on PM2.5, SO2, or NO2 levels in their specific neighbourhoods. Advocacy for remediation is hindered by lack of evidence.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy a low-cost particulate matter sensor network (20 nodes) across Jharia covering 80% of populated areas, with a public-facing real-time dashboard and historical trend analysis.
problems.constraints: Sensors must be solar-powered. Data to be publicly accessible. Low-cost (<₹5,000/node).

problems.title: Forest Fire Early Warning System for Saranda Forest Division
problems.situation: Saranda forest in West Singhbhum loses 8-12% of canopy annually to forest fires, threatening biodiversity and tribal livelihoods. Fires are detected 4-8 hours after ignition on average.
problems.gap: No automated detection system. Forest guards are insufficient in number (1 per 2,000 hectares). MODIS satellite alerts arrive with 24-hour delay.
problems.desired_outcome: Design and pilot a low-cost sensor-based early fire detection system for 500 hectares of Saranda with alert time under 30 minutes using smoke/temperature sensors and a forest guard mobile app.
problems.constraints: No cellular in forest. LoRaWAN or mesh radio required. Solar powered nodes.

problems.title: E-Marketplace for Jharkhand Tribal Handicrafts
problems.situation: Tribal artisans in Jharkhand produce world-class handicrafts (Dokra, Paitkar painting, Sohrai art) but earn ₹150-300/day on average, selling to middlemen at 15% of retail price.
problems.gap: No direct-to-consumer digital channel exists tailored to tribal artisans with low digital literacy. Existing platforms (Amazon, Flipkart) require documentation and banking sophistication these artisans lack.
problems.desired_outcome: Launch a simplified e-marketplace for 500 tribal artisans with assisted onboarding (via NGO partners), vernacular UI in Hindi, and direct bank transfer for sales — targeting 3x income increase for pilot group.
problems.constraints: Must work on 2G. Hindi UI. WhatsApp-based onboarding preferred. Zero upfront cost for artisans.

problems.title: MGNREGA Work Attendance Digitisation for Gram Panchayats in Giridih
problems.situation: 12 gram panchayats in Giridih struggle with paper-based MGNREGA attendance, leading to delayed wage payments (average 45 days) and 15% ghost worker fraud estimates.
problems.gap: No biometric or digital attendance system deployed at worksite level. Mates (supervisors) maintain paper muster rolls that are submitted weekly to block office.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy a GPS-enabled digital muster roll system for 12 panchayats with photo attendance capture, automated wage calculation, and direct submission to NIC payment system — reducing payment delays to <7 days.
problems.constraints: Works offline. Syncs when connectivity available. Android app. Mates have basic smartphones.

problems.title: Solar Micro-Grid for 8 Electrification-Deficit Villages in Gumla
problems.situation: 8 villages in Gumla have never been electrified despite DDUGJY scheme rollout.
problems.gap: Grid extension is not cost-effective due to terrain. No alternative energy solution deployed.
problems.desired_outcome: Design and pilot a 5kW solar micro-grid for 2 villages serving 200 households within 12 months.
problems.constraints: Tribal land rights constraints, community operation required

problems.title: Digital Health Record System for CHCs in Hazaribagh
problems.situation: Community Health Centres maintain paper records, causing duplicate tests and medication errors.
problems.gap: No electronic health record system. Patient history lost when transferred between facilities.
problems.desired_outcome: Implement a lightweight EHR for 5 CHCs in Hazaribagh district with patient identity using Aadhaar.
problems.constraints: Internet unreliable, offline-first required

problems.title: Crop Insurance Awareness and Enrolment Tool for Farmers in Bokaro
problems.situation: Only 8% of eligible farmers in Bokaro are enrolled in PMFBY crop insurance.
problems.gap: Low awareness, complex paper process, language barriers prevent enrolment.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy a Hindi voice-based guided enrolment assistant increasing PMFBY coverage to 25% in Bokaro within one Kharif season.
problems.constraints: Voice-only interface, works on feature phones

problems.title: Waste Segregation and Collection Optimisation for Jamshedpur Municipal Area
problems.situation: JMC collects 280 MT/day of mixed waste. 70% is landfilled though 50% is recyclable. Route planning is manual.
problems.gap: No source segregation system. Collection routes not optimised. No citizen reporting of overflow bins.
problems.desired_outcome: Implement source segregation pilot in 3 wards (50,000 households) with route optimisation reducing fuel cost 20%.
problems.constraints: Requires citizen behaviour change, app + awareness campaign

problems.title: Telemedicine for Eye Care in Remote Blocks of Dumka
problems.situation: Cataract blindness rate in Dumka is 4x state average. Only 1 ophthalmologist for 3 lakh population.
problems.gap: No tele-ophthalmology solution connects community health workers with specialists in Ranchi.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy a tele-eye-care system connecting 20 health workers in Dumka with 3 specialist doctors in Ranchi, targeting 500 cataract surgeries referred per year.
problems.constraints: 2G connectivity, basic Android phone

problems.title: Skill Mapping Platform for ITI Graduates in Dhanbad
problems.situation: 3,000 ITI graduates annually in Dhanbad district face unemployment despite industry demand for skilled workers.
problems.gap: No digital platform connects ITI graduates with MSME employers. Placement is word-of-mouth.
problems.desired_outcome: Build a skill-verified job matching portal for ITI graduates and Dhanbad MSMEs, targeting 500 placements in Year 1.
problems.constraints: Mobile-first, Hindi interface

problems.title: Community Library Network with Digital Resources in Deoghar
problems.situation: 15 gram panchayats in Deoghar lack any library or reading room. Youth have no access to competitive exam preparation materials.
problems.gap: No physical or digital library infrastructure. Internet cafes charge ₹30/hour — unaffordable for students.
problems.desired_outcome: Establish 5 community digital learning centres with offline NCERT library, competitive exam materials, and coaching in 15 panchayats within 6 months.
problems.constraints: Offline content required, community-operated

problems.title: Groundwater Level Monitoring Network for Ranchi Urban Area
problems.situation: Ranchi's groundwater table has dropped 6m in urban areas in the past 15 years due to unregulated extraction.
problems.gap: Only 8 CGWB monitoring wells exist for 15 lakh population. No real-time monitoring.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy 50 low-cost groundwater level sensors across Ranchi with public dashboard and automated alerts when critical thresholds are crossed.
problems.constraints: Solar powered sensors, low cost, open data

problems.title: Animal Disease Surveillance App for Livestock Farmers in Giridih
problems.situation: Livestock disease outbreaks affect 20,000 farming families in Giridih annually, causing ₹15 crore in losses. Reporting is delayed by 7-14 days.
problems.gap: Veterinary assistants use paper forms. No geospatial outbreak mapping. Disease spread goes undetected for weeks.
problems.desired_outcome: Deploy a mobile disease reporting and mapping system for 200 veterinary assistants in Giridih with real-time outbreak alerts and containment guidance.
problems.constraints: Offline capable, low-end Android

problems.title: Air Quality and Noise Monitoring for Hazaribagh Urban Area
problems.situation: Hazaribagh town lacks any environmental monitoring. Residents near the highway and industrial areas report health issues.
problems.gap: No data on PM2.5, noise levels, or vehicle emissions. Urban planning decisions lack environmental evidence.
problems.desired_outcome: Install 10 low-cost air quality and noise sensors at strategic urban locations with a public-facing real-time dashboard.
problems.constraints: Solar powered, weatherproof, open data
